title: Soviet target-mice psi experiment in the Urals

tellings.quote: 12 and bottom 12 it was a perfect match all the bottom ones were controls all the top ones were Target mice

plain: A Soviet psychic research unit is said to have run an experiment in the Ural Mountains in which some mice were chosen as targets and others kept as controls, and the results came out with the top 12 all target mice and the bottom 12 all controls. Joe McMoneagle, a former US Army remote viewer (someone trained to describe distant places or events by mind alone), tells Michels he read this in a box of material from the Soviet unit and calls it "a perfect match". If true, the Soviets had a clean result showing a mind could pick out or affect living targets.
